revision: Corrective candidate adds a mechanically consumable DNS-REQ-002 local-request boundary matrix; Git delivery revision and content SHA-256 are recorded in completion-report.md.

source_artifacts.path: RFC 1035 sections 4.1-4.2.2, RFC 7766 sections 4-5 and 8, RFC 9619 section 4, RFC 3597 section 3, RFC 6891 section 6.1.2
source_artifacts.revision: official RFC Editor text independently consulted 2026-09-19; byte derivations are stated per case

assumptions: UDP-first unicast stub/client profile; TCP appears only after a correlated UDP TC response.
The deterministic ID 0x1a2b is a vector seam, not a prescription for production ID generation.
Named endpoint values below are logical correlation metadata; no socket implementation is implied.
open_questions: Numerical default limits are intentionally not fixed. Limit vectors set an explicit local configured limit.
limitations: No EDNS query construction, typed-RDATA decoder, TCP reuse/pipelining capability, retry policy, or binding adapter is specified.
This authoring candidate is not a G5 approval and does not authorize G6 or implementation.

DNS-REQ-027 has no G5 canonical vector: it is a residual plain-UDP authenticity risk whose approved planned evidence is downstream security-review and documentation/metadata, not a wire behavior asserted here.

cases.description: Build an RD=1 A/IN query for Example.COM with deterministic ID.
cases.request_text: DNS header ID=0x1a2b, flags=0x0100, QDCOUNT=1; QNAME labels Example COM root; QTYPE=A; QCLASS=IN.
cases.response_text: No response in this construction vector.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 4.1.1/4.1.2: 12-octet network-order header and QNAME/QTYPE/QCLASS; approved DNS-REQ-001/002/003/005.

emitted_dns_message.framing: complete DNS message; no UDP or TCP framing

cases.coverage_notes: Exact bytes; QNAME has no compression pointer.

cases.description: Root A/IN query with RD omitted.
cases.request_text: Root QNAME is the single zero octet; flags are zero.
cases.response_text: No response.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 2.3.4 and 4.1.2; approved DNS-REQ-002/005.

emitted_dns_message.framing: complete DNS message; no transport prefix

cases.coverage_notes: Root boundary and response-only flags absent.

cases.description: Reject a 64-octet label locally without I/O.

logical_input.name: 64 ASCII a octets followed by root

cases.request_text: No wire request is valid because a DNS label exceeds 63 octets.
cases.response_text: None.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 2.3.4; approved DNS-REQ-002 and TR-LOCAL-REJECT.
cases.coverage_notes: One principal local fault; no speculative bytes.

cases.description: Accept a correlated mixed-case response with one compressed A RR.
preconditions: context ID=0x1a2b qname=example.com. A IN peer=192.0.2.53:53 local=192.0.2.10:53000 transport=UDP

logical_input.answer: owner pointer to question; A IN TTL 300 RDATA 192.0.2.1

cases.request_text: Already pending as DNS-VEC-001 logical request.
cases.response_text: QR=1,RD=1,RA=1; one echoed question and one A answer. The answer NAME c00c points to the original QNAME at offset 12.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 4.1.1/4.1.3/4.1.4; RFC 4343 case-insensitive comparison; approved DNS-REQ-007/009/010/012/013/015.
cases.coverage_notes: Compression cursor advances two parent bytes; dereference does not increase consumption.

cases.description: Retain unknown ordinary RR TYPE 65000 as exact opaque RDATA.

logical_input.response: one question; one TYPE65000 IN RR with RDATA deadbe

cases.response_text: Unknown ordinary RR is structurally complete and its RDATA is opaque.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 4.1.3; RFC 3597 section 3; approved DNS-REQ-010/011.
cases.coverage_notes: Not an OPT/meta RR; type-specific decoding is forbidden.

cases.description: A valid correlated NXDOMAIN is a complete DNS-status outcome, not malformed or transport failure.
preconditions: context ID=0x1a2b qname=example.com. A IN and matching peer
cases.response_text: QR=1,RD=1,RA=1,RCODE=3, one echoed question and no RRs.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 4.1.1; approved DNS-REQ-015.
cases.coverage_notes: Separates DNS outcome from local failure.

cases.description: Correlated UDP datagram shorter than the DNS header is terminal malformed.
cases.response_text: 11 octets cannot form the required 12-octet header.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 4.1.1; approved DNS-REQ-006/023.
cases.coverage_notes: No partial header/result exposure.

cases.description: Correlated QUERY response with QDCOUNT=2 is malformed.
cases.response_text: The complete packet has two valid question encodings but violates the profile QDCOUNT rule.
cases.provenance: RFC 9619 section 4; approved DNS-REQ-014/023.
cases.coverage_notes: Principal fault is QDCOUNT, not question encoding.

cases.description: Reserved Z header bit set in an otherwise correlated response is terminal malformed.
cases.response_text: Flags 0x81c0 set the reserved Z bit.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 4.1.1; approved DNS-REQ-016/023.
cases.coverage_notes: AD/CD are not conflated with the reserved bit.

cases.description: Self-referential QNAME compression pointer is rejected.

logical_input.question_qname: pointer c00c at offset 12 points to itself

cases.response_text: QR response header plus QNAME c00c; pointer target is not earlier than the pointer location.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 4.1.4; approved DNS-REQ-008/009/023.
cases.coverage_notes: No forward/self pointer following is allowed.

cases.description: RDLENGTH must not exceed present RDATA bytes.

logical_input.answer: A RR declares RDLENGTH=4 but contains 3 bytes

cases.response_text: Owner compression pointer c00c, A/IN, RDLENGTH=4, only c00002 present.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 4.1.3; approved DNS-REQ-007/010/023.
cases.coverage_notes: Exact enclosing-message bound applies to RDATA.

cases.description: Structurally valid correlated OPT is rejected as unsupported_extension, not an unknown ordinary RR.

logical_input.additional: root OPT type 41 class 512 TTL 0 RDLENGTH 0

cases.response_text: One echoed question; ARCOUNT=1; OPT pseudo-RR follows.
cases.provenance: RFC 6891 6.1.1/6.1.2; approved DNS-REQ-025 and ordered unsupported-extension disposition.
cases.coverage_notes: OPT disposition is distinct from malformed bytes.

cases.description: Wrong-ID UDP response is ignored and leaves the request pending.
preconditions: context ID=0x1a2b qname=example.com. A IN selected peer/local endpoint
cases.response_text: Structurally valid response but ID mismatches outstanding context.
cases.provenance: RFC 5452 correlation guidance; approved DNS-REQ-013/017/023 and TR-IGNORE-NONMATCHING-UDP.
cases.coverage_notes: Nonmatching is not malformed matching input.

cases.description: Correlated UDP TC response transitions to TCP; split TCP prefix/body then publish one response.
preconditions: context ID=0x1a2b qname=example.com. A IN; TCP fallback peer is same resolver
cases.request_text: The original logical query is preserved for TCP fallback.
cases.response_text: UDP partial content is discarded. TCP prefix 001d is outside the 29-byte DNS message.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 4.1.1/4.2.2 and RFC 7766 section 4/8; approved DNS-REQ-018/019/022.

payload.framing: exact declared TCP DNS message body

tcp_frame_prefix.framing: TCP prefix only; outside DNS message

cases.coverage_notes: Ordered stateful scenario; total TCP frame consumption is 31 bytes across three parser calls. Explicitly traces UDP-first and TC-triggered TCP fallback to DNS-REQ-021.

cases.description: A zero-length TCP DNS frame is terminal malformed after consuming only its prefix.
cases.response_text: TCP length prefix 0000 has no DNS body and is invalid for this profile.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 4.2.2; approved DNS-REQ-019/023 and TR-TCP-INVALID-FRAME.

payload.framing: complete TCP length prefix declaring zero body

cases.coverage_notes: Prefix is framing, not a DNS message.

cases.description: One parse step accepts exactly one nonmatching completed frame and leaves a coalesced matching frame caller-owned.
cases.response_text: First framed response is nonmatching and ignored; implementation must not consume the second frame in the same parse step.
cases.provenance: RFC 7766 sections 7-8; approved DOM-CONSUMPTION, TR-TCP-IGNORE-NONMATCHING, DNS-REQ-019/020.
cases.coverage_notes: Tests one-frame-per-step and isolation; second frame is intentionally not decoded in this case.

cases.description: Configured TCP body limit rejects an oversized declared frame at prefix time.
cases.response_text: Declared 29-byte body exceeds explicit configured bound of 28. This prefix-time case makes no claim about precedence against a later malformed or excluded-extension body.
cases.provenance: Approved DNS-REQ-024 and ordered DOM-TCP-CORRELATED-DISPOSITION (resource-limit first); RFC 1035 TCP u16 framing.
cases.coverage_notes: The numerical bound is an explicit vector precondition, not an invented default. This is only prefix-time size rejection; it does not assert a competing later classification.

cases.description: Deadline and cancellation are local terminal events with no result publication.
preconditions: two independent pending contexts: udp-request and tcp-fallback-request

logical_input.events: deadline on UDP request; cancellation on TCP fallback request

cases.response_text: No DNS response bytes.
cases.provenance: Approved DNS-REQ-004/017/022, TR-TERMINAL-ERROR and TR-CANCEL.
cases.coverage_notes: Two independent scenarios in one interaction vector; neither is a DNS response.

cases.description: Matching-ID UDP candidates with wrong echoed question tuple or endpoint/transport metadata are ignored independently and retain the pending context.
preconditions: context ID=0x1a2b qname=example.com. A IN peer=192.0.2.53:53 local=192.0.2.10:53000 transport=UDP deadline=100ms

logical_input.all_payloads: otherwise structurally valid QR=1 QUERY response

cases.response_text: Each received candidate has the outstanding ID and a complete one-question response but fails exactly one required correlation dimension.
cases.provenance: Approved DNS-REQ-013/017; model TR-IGNORE-NONMATCHING-UDP requires ID/question/peer/local-address-port/transport correlation and preserves context/deadline.

peer/local endpoints otherwise match but received transport=TCP, not pending UDP

output_events.action: each nonmatching candidate has no result or terminal effect

cases.coverage_notes: Endpoint metadata is explicit for peer, local destination port, and transport; each event has one principal mismatch.

cases.description: A complete matching-ID response with IQUERY opcode cannot complete a standard QUERY and is ignored as nonmatching/unsupported.
preconditions: context ID=0x1a2b qname=example.com. A IN peer/local/transport match
cases.response_text: Flags 0x8900 encode QR=1, OPCODE=1 (IQUERY), and RD=1; all remaining correlation fields match.
cases.provenance: Approved DNS-REQ-013 and DNS-REQ-026: a wire response whose opcode is not QUERY is nonmatching/unsupported and cannot complete the standard query; model nonmatching disposition retains pending context.

output_events.action: non-QUERY opcode is not accepted as the pending standard QUERY response

cases.coverage_notes: Exact flags establish OPCODE != QUERY. The approved nonmatching/unsupported outcome is nonterminal ignore for this outstanding standard query.

cases.description: A bounded Authority-section NS RR parses after Answer and before Additional and consumes the exact message end.
preconditions: context ID=0x1a2b qname=example.com. A IN matching peer/local/transport

logical_input.authority_rr: owner pointer to question; NS IN TTL 0; RDLENGTH 2; RDATA pointer to question name

cases.response_text: Header declares one Authority RR only. After the echoed Question, the NS RR is c00c 0002 0001 00000000 0002 c00c.
cases.provenance: RFC 1035 4.1.3 section order and compressed names; approved DNS-REQ-007/009/010/023.

output_events.action: one result with one Authority NS RR

cases.coverage_notes: Both owner and NS RDATA use in-message pointer c00c; parent consumption includes each two-octet pointer and totals 43 bytes.

cases.description: EOF during an incomplete TCP body is terminal transport failure with no partial DNS result.
preconditions: fallback context ID=0x1a2b qname=example.com. A IN; TCP accumulator empty
cases.response_text: Prefix 001d declares a 29-byte DNS body. Ten body octets follow, then the transport reports EOF.
cases.provenance: Approved DNS-REQ-019 and error/recovery profile: EOF interrupts a frame and is ERR-TRANSPORT; model TR-TCP-INVALID-FRAME and TR-TERMINAL-ERROR require accumulator/context cleanup and no result.
cases.coverage_notes: The 12 accepted bytes are 2 prefix plus 10 incomplete body octets. EOF itself contributes no payload bytes.

cases.description: A correlated complete DNS message with one trailing octet after all declared sections is terminal malformed.
preconditions: context ID=0x1a2b qname=example.com. A IN matching endpoint metadata
cases.response_text: The valid 29-byte header/question message is followed by ff although all section counts are exhausted.
cases.provenance: Approved DNS-REQ-007 requires parse to end exactly; DNS-REQ-023 classifies response trailing bytes as terminal malformed.

output_events.action: terminal malformed response; consume complete UDP datagram

cases.coverage_notes: Exact end-of-message assertion: 29 bytes are structurally declared; the 30th ff is forbidden trailing input.
